newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wah Tak Fung to issue 138 mln shrs at HK$1.88 each.
newsitem.headline: Wah Tak Fung to issue 138 mln shrs at HK$1.88 each.

text.p: Hong Kong-based property investment and development group Wah Tak Fung Holdings Ltd said on Monday it planned to issue 138 million new shares at HK$1.88 per share, raising a net of HK$245 million.
The public offer will be from September 17 to 20 and dealing in the shares is expected to begin on September 30.

The proceeds will be mainly used for the funding of future acquisitions of land, properties and property interests for the company's business in Hong Kong, Wah Tak Fung said in a statement. The remaining balance would be for working capital.
Wah Tak Fung estimated that its profit after-tax and minority interest but before extraordinary items for the year ending March 31, 1997, will be not less than HK$80 million.
Crosby Capital Markets (Asia) Ltd and Amsteel Corporate Fianance (HK) Ltd are the sponsors of the new issue.

Wah Tak Fung engages in property development and investment in Hong Kong with particular emphasis on Grade B office space, and in the provision of property management services to properties developed or acquired by it.

Its property portfolio, comprising office and residential property in the proportion of 84 and 16 percent respectively, is valued at HK$2.565 billion or a net asset value of HK$2.76 per share, the company said.
